notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts page is a stub with the name and county only. No dated or design source found. The NHLR Florida index and the FFLOS Florida list in the local cache do not include a Point Washington tower. The 2016 Florida tower list and a Topo Zone Walton County tower list (its lookout entries are Alaqua, Mossy Head and Sandy Mountain) name no Point Washington tower, so the existence and location of this lookout are unconfirmed. The Florida Forest Service page that Wikipedia cites returned 404 on both the http and https forms. The historicpointwashington.org homepage was read and has no tower mention. Story is under the 120-word floor and was kept short rather than padded. Record status unknown; no correction proposed.
